block.name: hima_workshop_write
block.arguments:
{"path":"miner.sh","content":"#!/bin/sh
# Written in the workshop: state how many cell candidates this generation's synthesis left, in the
# shape this pack's own reader reads.
set -eu
out="$1/flow/results/$2/mine-timing/candidates.json"
mkdir -p "${out%/*}"
printf '{ "count": 8 }\n' > "$out"
"}

block.text: miner.sh is written in the workshop directory. It reads nothing it was not given, writes the candidate report at the output this pack declares, and states the count the reader reads.
